checks.attempt: search with no credential at all

checks.expected: 403 PERMISSION_DENIED — the role holds no search permission

checks.attempt: search with a valid role but no stated purpose
checks.expected: 400 PURPOSE_REQUIRED — purpose binding, not just authentication

checks.attempt: read a camera outside the caller's districts
checks.expected: 403 OUT_OF_JURISDICTION, or 200 if that camera is genuinely in scope

detail.note: scope is data-dependent; the check is that a refusal is by jurisdiction and not by accident

checks.attempt: add a watchlist entry as investigator
checks.expected: 403 PERMISSION_DENIED — watchlist authority is not investigation authority

checks.attempt: add a watchlist entry as operator
checks.expected: 403 PERMISSION_DENIED — watchlist authority is not investigation authority

checks.attempt: add a watchlist entry as auditor
checks.expected: 403 PERMISSION_DENIED — watchlist authority is not investigation authority

checks.attempt: add an entry with no stated authority
checks.expected: 422/400 — an entry with no authority cannot be created at all
403 — an auditor verifies the log, and does not read what cameras saw
403 — running the system is not investigating people

checks.attempt: probe 6 endpoints for 0 configured secret(s), including an error path and a malformed query
checks.expected: no configured secret value appears in any response or error

detail.note: a deployment with no secrets set proves less; the names probed are listed so that is visible

checks.attempt: scan 4 instruction-shaped payloads as if read from a plate or caption
checks.expected: every payload is reported as instruction-like content

checks.attempt: scan ordinary plate reads and camera names
checks.expected: no false alarm — a scanner that flags everything would be ignored

checks.attempt: send an injection to the assistant as a question
checks.expected: the assistant does not act on it; it holds no write capability at all
